meaning: An AI made by Anthropic. It's a chatbot, a computer program built to talk with people. Ask it questions or hand it tasks.
clues: It isn't a person, but it answers when you ask it something.
You can hand it a task, not just a question.
It's made by a company called Anthropic.
It shares its name with a man's first name.
Its name has six letters and starts with C.

decoys.meaning: Google's AI assistant. You can upload a long document and it sums it up for you.
Microsoft's AI assistant. It can search the web and give short summaries with sources.
An AI from OpenAI. You chat with it to get answers and find ideas.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Try it with someone you trust. In your phone's browser, open claude.ai or gemini.google.com. Ask it to explain a word you don't know, then check what it says.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Good, check what it says. We looked things up in a book or asked a librarian. The smart ones still checked a second source.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: If a site asks you to sign in, let that person show you. Don't type passwords or bank numbers into a chatbot.

why: AI chatbots are easy to find now, so know what they are and check their answers.
